Simulation was run with ny = 41 giving nx = 601 (solver ensures same spatial discretisation in each dimension)
in solver.py 1e-7 was used for u and v, 1e-4 for p

ran with:

run_solver = make_solver(ny=grid_size, nx=None, ab2=True, implicit_diffusion=False)

t_end = 400

x, y, U_data, V_data, Omega_data, Stream_data, my_rank, u_original, v_original = run_solver(Re, tol=1e-4, t_end=t_end, fixed=False)


giving: (note my re = 200 is equivalent to re=400 in the papers due to the length scale difference)
